name: Dosfstools
description: FAT filesystem creation and checking tools for EFI and removable media.

smoke_commands: img=/tmp/auzix-fat-smoke-$$.img; trap 'rm -f "$img"' EXIT; truncate -s 4M "$img" && $AUZIX_COMMAND_ROOT/mkfs.fat -I -n AUZIXTEST "$img" && $AUZIX_COMMAND_ROOT/fsck.fat -n "$img" && $AUZIX_COMMAND_ROOT/fatlabel "$img" | grep -F AUZIXTEST
